macros.name: dtladdalign
macros.doc: Adds tabular column alignment character to ⟨cs⟩ for column ⟨col num⟩ which contains data type ⟨type⟩.

macros.name: dtladdall
macros.doc: Defines ⟨cs⟩ to the sum of all the numbers in the comma-separated list of numbers.

macros.name: DTLaddentryforrow
macros.doc: Adds the entry with key given by ⟨key⟩ and value given by ⟨value⟩ to the first row in the database ⟨db name⟩ which satisfies the condition given by ⟨condition⟩.

macros.name: dtlaftercols
macros.doc: This specifies what to put after the last column alignment specifier.

macros.name: dtlappendentrytocurrentrow
macros.doc: Appends an entry with the given ⟨value⟩ to \dtlcurrentrow for the column identified by ⟨col key⟩.

macros.name: DTLappendtorow
macros.doc: Appends an entry with the protected expansion of ⟨value⟩ to the current row for the column identified by ⟨col-key⟩.

macros.name: DTLassignfirstmatch
macros.doc: Applies the assignment list to the first row that has the given value in the given column.

macros.name: dtlbeforecols
macros.doc: This specifies what to put before the first column alignment specifier.

macros.name: dtlbeforerow
macros.doc: Define token register to store everything before the current row.

macros.name: dtlbetweencols
macros.doc: This specifies what to put between the column alignment specifiers.

macros.name: DTLcleardb
macros.doc: Clears the database.

macros.name: DTLcolumncount
macros.doc: Expands to the number of columns in the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: dtlcolumnindex
macros.doc: This will expand to 0 if the database or column don’t exist, otherwise it will expand to the column index.

macros.name: DTLcomputebounds
macros.doc: Computes the maximum and minimum x and y values over all the databases listed in ⟨db list⟩ where the x value is given by ⟨x key⟩ and the y value is given by ⟨y key⟩.

macros.name: dtlcurrencyformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with currency data type.

macros.name: DTLcurrencytype
macros.doc: Data type representing currency.

macros.name: dtldatealign
macros.doc: Alignment character for columns containing dates.

macros.name: dtldateformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with date data type.

macros.name: dtldatetimealign
macros.doc: Alignment character for columns containing timestamps.

macros.name: dtldatetimeformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with datetime data type.

macros.name: DTLdefaultEURcurrencyfmt
macros.doc: The default definition is just \dtlcurrdefaultfmt but this makes it possible to vary the format of EUR specifically without affecting other currencies.

macros.name: dtldefaultkey
macros.doc: Default key to use if none specified (column index will be appended).

macros.name: DTLdeletedb
macros.doc: Deletes the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩ (that is, the internal commands associated with the database are undefined).

macros.name: dtldisplayafterhead
macros.doc: Indicates what to do after the header row, before the first row of data.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydb
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a tabular environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydbAddBegin
macros.doc: Used by \DTLdisplaydb to add the beginning of the tabular environment to the ⟨content-tlvar⟩ token list variable.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydbAddItem
macros.doc: This command is used to append an item to the ⟨content-tl-var⟩ token list variable.

macros.name: dtldisplayendtab
macros.doc: Indicates what to do just before \end{tabular}.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdb
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a longtable environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdbAddBegin
macros.doc: Analogous to \DTLdisplaydbAddBegin but used by \DTLdisplaylongdb to add the start of the longtable environment to ⟨content-tl-var⟩.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdbAddEnd
macros.doc: Adds the end longtable code to ⟨content-tl-var⟩ for \DTLdisplaylongdb.

macros.name: dtldisplaystarttab
macros.doc: Indicates what to do just after \begin{tabular}{⟨column specs⟩} (e.g. \hline).

macros.name: DTLdisplayTBrowidxmap
macros.doc: Provided for use with row-idx-map-function, this command expands to a row index that will arrange data rows from top to bottom instead of left to right when per-row is greater than 1.

macros.name: DTLfetch
macros.doc: Fetches and displays the value for ⟨column2 name⟩ in the first row where the value of ⟨column1 name⟩ is ⟨column1 value⟩.

macros.name: dtlforcolumn
macros.doc: Iterates through column given by ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlforcolumnidx
macros.doc: Iterates through the column with index ⟨col num⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: DTLforeach
macros.doc: For each row of data in the database given by ⟨db name⟩, do ⟨text⟩, if the specified conditions are satisfied.

macros.name: dtlforeachkey
macros.doc: Iterates through all the keys in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlforeachlevel
macros.doc: The current level register is incremented at the start of \DTLforeach and corresponds to the level index.

macros.name: DTLgcleardb
macros.doc: Globally clears the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩, regardless of the global setting.

macros.name: DTLgdeletedb
macros.doc: Globally deletes the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩, regardless of the global setting.

macros.name: DTLget
macros.doc: This will define the (token list variable) control sequence ⟨cs⟩ to the value obtained from the most recent \DTLaction in the current scope.

macros.name: DTLgetdatatype
macros.doc: Gets data type associated with column labelled ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩ and stores in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetentryfromcurrentrow
macros.doc: This gets the value from the \dtlcurrentrow register for the column with the index ⟨col num⟩ and stores the value in the control sequence ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetkeyforcolumn
macros.doc: Gets the key associated with the given column index and stores in ⟨key cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetlocation
macros.doc: Assigns ⟨row cs⟩ and ⟨column cs⟩ to the indices of the first entry in ⟨database⟩ that matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetrow
macros.doc: Gets row with index ⟨row idx⟩ from database named ⟨db⟩ and stores the row in \dtlcurrentrow, the preceding rows in \dtlbeforerow and the following rows in \dtlafterrow.

macros.name: DTLgetrowforkey
macros.doc: This (globally) sets ⟨cmd⟩ (a control sequence) to the first row of the database called ⟨db name⟩ which contains the key ⟨ref key⟩ that has the value ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetrowforvalue
macros.doc: Like \dtlgetrow, but gets the row where the entry in column ⟨column index⟩ matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetrowindex
macros.doc: Gets the row index for the first row in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩ where the entry in the column given by its index ⟨col idx⟩ exactly matches the given ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetrowindex
macros.doc: Assigns ⟨row cs⟩ to the row index of the first entry in ⟨database⟩ where the entry in ⟨column index⟩ matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetvalue
macros.doc: Gets the element in row ⟨r⟩, column ⟨c⟩ from database ⟨db⟩ and stores in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgnewdb
macros.doc: Globally defines a new database with the label ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: dtlheader
macros.doc: Defined by \DTLforeachkeyinrow to the current column header.

macros.name: dtlheaderformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format the column title.

macros.name: DTLifaction
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the last action (within the current scope) set the return value identified by ⟨property⟩, otherwise it expands to ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifcurrencyunit
macros.doc: This tests if ⟨arg⟩ is currency, and uses the currency unit ⟨symbol⟩.

macros.name: DTLifdbempty
macros.doc: Check if named database is empty (i.e. no rows have been added).

macros.name: DTLifdbexists
macros.doc: Checks if a data base with the given name exists.

macros.name: DTLiffirstrow
macros.doc: Test if the current row is the first row.

macros.name: DTLiflastrow
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩, if this row is the last (that satisfies the condition).

macros.name: DTLiflt
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumlt if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringlt (unstarred version) or \DTLifstringlt* (starred version).

macros.name: DTLifnull
macros.doc: Checks if ⟨command⟩ is null (either \DTLstringnull or \DTLnumbernull) if true, does ⟨true part⟩ otherwise does ⟨false part⟩.

macros.name: dtlifnumeq
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ equals ⟨num2⟩ otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifoddrow
macros.doc: Determines whether the current row is odd (takes the optional argument of \DTLforeach into account.)

macros.name: DTLifreal
macros.doc: Parses ⟨arg⟩ and does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨arg⟩ is a real (decimal) formatted number or is in scientific notation, otherwise it does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: dtlintformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with integer data type.

macros.name: DTLinttype
macros.doc: Data type representing integers.

macros.name: dtllastloadeddb
macros.doc: Expands to the label of the last database to be loaded by \DTLread.

macros.name: dtllettergroup
macros.doc: By default, this expands to \text_titlecase_first:n{⟨character⟩}.

macros.name: dtlmapcurrentrow
macros.doc: Iterates over the columns of the current row.

macros.name: DTLmapdata
macros.doc: Iterates over the data in a database, performing ⟨loop-body⟩ at each iteration.

macros.name: DTLmapget
macros.doc: Gets the value of the given key in the current row.

macros.name: DTLmaprow
macros.doc: Maps over the columns in the current row.

macros.name: DTLmaprowbreak
macros.doc: This will stop the current \DTLmaprow loop at that point but won’t stop the \DTLmapdata loop.

macros.name: DTLmaxforcolumn
macros.doc: This determines the maximum value over all numeric items in the column with the label ⟨key⟩ of the database identified by ⟨db⟩ and stores the result as a formatted number in the control sequence ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: DTLmaxforkeys
macros.doc: Determines the maximum value over all numeric values in the columns identified by the keys in the comma-separated ⟨key list⟩ for all databases listed in the comma-separated ⟨db list⟩ and assigns ⟨cmd⟩ to the result as a formatted number.

macros.name: DTLmeanforcolumn
macros.doc: This computes the mean over all numeric items in the column with the label ⟨key⟩ of the database identified by ⟨db⟩ and stores the result as a formatted number in the control sequence ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: DTLmeanforkeys
macros.doc: Computes the mean (average) of all numeric values in the columns identified by the keys in the comma-separated ⟨key list⟩ for all databases listed in the comma-separated ⟨db list⟩ and assigns ⟨cmd⟩ to the result as a formatted number.

macros.name: DTLminforcolumn
macros.doc: This determines the minimum value over all numeric items in the column with the label ⟨key⟩ of the database identified by ⟨db⟩ and stores the result as a formatted number in the control sequence ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: DTLminforkeys
macros.doc: Determines the minimum value over all numeric values in the columns identified by the keys in the comma-separated ⟨key list⟩ for all databases listed in the comma-separated ⟨db list⟩ and assigns ⟨cmd⟩ to the result as a formatted number.

macros.name: DTLnewdb
macros.doc: Initialises a database called ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: DTLnewdbentry
macros.doc: Adds an entry to the last row (adds new row if database is empty) and updates general column information if necessary.

macros.name: DTLnewrow
macros.doc: Add a new row to named database.

macros.name: dtlnoexpandnewvalue
macros.doc: Prevents new values from being expanded when added to a database (equivalent to the new -value-expand=false option).

macros.name: dtlnonlettergroup
macros.doc: By default, this simply expands to ⟨character⟩.

macros.name: dtlnumbergroup
macros.doc: By default, this simply expands to ⟨num⟩.

macros.name: dtlnumericformat
macros.doc: Used to format values in columns with a numeric data type.

macros.name: DTLpar
macros.doc: This is a robust command that simply does \par.

macros.name: DTLPreProcessDecimalGroup
macros.doc: This is used when ⟨num⟩ has been identified as a decimal.

macros.name: DTLrawmap
macros.doc: Additional mappings to perform when reading a raw data file.

macros.name: dtlrealformat
macros.doc: Used to format values in columns with the decimal data type.

macros.name: DTLrealtype
macros.doc: Data type representing real numbers.

macros.name: dtlrecombineomitcurrent
macros.doc: Like \dtlrecombine but omits \dtlcurrentrow.

macros.name: DTLremovecurrentrow
macros.doc: Removes the current row from the database.

macros.name: DTLremoveentryfromrow
macros.doc: Removes entry given by ⟨key⟩ from current row.

macros.name: DTLreplaceentryforrow
macros.doc: Replaces entry given by ⟨key⟩ in current row with ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlreplaceentryincurrentrow
macros.doc: Replaces the entry for the column identified by the index ⟨col idx⟩ in \dtlcurrentrow with the given value ⟨new value⟩.

macros.name: DTLrmentry
macros.doc: Only available with \DTLmapdata and read-only=false, this command will remove a column from the current iteration row.

macros.name: DTLrmrow
macros.doc: Removes the current iteration row.

macros.name: dtlroot
macros.doc: Nth root number and store the result in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: dtlround
macros.doc: Rounds ⟨num⟩ to ⟨dp⟩ decimal places and stores the result in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLrowcount
macros.doc: Expands to the number of rows in the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: DTLrowincr
macros.doc: Increment counter for the next level.

macros.name: dtlrownum
macros.doc: Count register to keep track of row index.

macros.name: DTLrowreset
macros.doc: Reset counter for the next level.

macros.name: DTLsavelastrowcount
macros.doc: Stores the maximum row count for the last \DTLforeach.

macros.name: DTLsavetexdb
macros.doc: Save a database as a LaTeX file.

macros.name: dtlsdforall
macros.doc: Defines ⟨cs⟩ to the standard deviation of all the values in the comma-separated list of numbers.

macros.name: DTLsdforcolumn
macros.doc: This computes the standard deviation of all numeric items in the column with the label ⟨key⟩ of the database identified by ⟨db⟩ and stores the result as a formatted number in the control sequence ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: DTLsdforkeys
macros.doc: Computes the standard deviation of all entries for each key in ⟨key list⟩ over all databases in ⟨db list⟩, and stores in ⟨cmd⟩, which must be a control sequence.

macros.name: DTLsetcurrencydatum
macros.doc: Sets ⟨cs⟩ to a currency datum.

macros.name: DTLsetdefaultcurrency
macros.doc: \DTLsetdefaultcurrency{⟨symbol⟩} sets the default currency.

macros.name: DTLsetdelimiter
macros.doc: This sets the delimiter.

macros.name: DTLsetentry
macros.doc: Sets the column identified by either column or key to the value identified by value or expand-value or expand-once-value.

macros.name: DTLsetheader
macros.doc: Sets header for column given by ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlsort
macros.doc: Sorts the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩ using the given ⟨handler-cs⟩ function for the comparisons, which should be of the type described in §2.9.5.1.

macros.name: DTLsort
macros.doc: Sorts database ⟨db name⟩ according to {⟨sort criteria⟩}, which must be a comma separated list of keys, and optionally =⟨order⟩, where ⟨order⟩ is either ascending or descending.

macros.name: DTLsortdata
macros.doc: This command sorts the data (in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩) according to the given criteria.

macros.name: dtlspecialvalue
macros.doc: This simply expands to its argument but its presence at the start of a value indicates that special treatment is required for that entry when adding the entry to the database and when writing the database to a DBTEX file.

macros.name: dtlsplitrow
macros.doc: Splits the row around the entry given by ⟨col num⟩.

macros.name: DTLstoreinitials
macros.doc: Convert a string into initials and store in ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: dtlstringformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with string data type.

macros.name: DTLstringtype
macros.doc: Data type representing strings.

macros.name: DTLsumcolumn
macros.doc: This sums over all numeric items in the column with the label ⟨key⟩ of the database identified by ⟨db⟩ and stores the result as a formatted number in the control sequence ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: DTLsumforkeys
macros.doc: Sums all numeric values in the columns identified by the keys in the comma-separated ⟨key list⟩ for all databases listed in the comma-separated ⟨db list⟩ and assigns ⟨cmd⟩ to the total as a formatted number.

macros.name: dtlswaprows
macros.doc: Swaps the rows with indices ⟨row1 idx⟩ and ⟨row2 idx⟩ in the database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: DTLtherow
macros.doc: Show the counter for the next level.

macros.name: dtltimealign
macros.doc: Alignment character for columns containing times.

macros.name: dtltimeformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with time data type.

macros.name: DTLunsettype
macros.doc: This expands to nothing and so can be used to check for the unset ID.

macros.name: DTLuse
macros.doc: This gets the primary or secondary return value and then uses it.

macros.name: DTLvarianceforcolumn
macros.doc: Quicker version of \DTLvarianceforkeys that just computes the variance over one column (specified by ⟨key⟩) for a single database (specified by ⟨db⟩) and stores the result in ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: DTLvarianceforkeys
macros.doc: Computes the variance of all entries for each key in ⟨key list⟩ over all databases in ⟨db list⟩, and stores in ⟨cmd⟩, which must be a control sequence.

macros.name: DTLwrite
macros.doc: Saves the data from a database to the file given by ⟨filename⟩.

macros.name: xDTLassignfirstmatch
macros.doc: Applies the assignment list to the first row that has the given value in the given column.
